Start smaller than you think you need to. The purpose is to support movement, not to demand a particular mood.

The activity suggestions reuse the 225-item source library from Emotion Regulation Handout 16. [Review the source-backed Behavioural Activation lesson](/learn/wellness/behavioral-activation.html).
